verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own observability docs describe session screen recording and replay through the Browserbase session dashboard. That covers the video-replay part of the story, but only when runs use Browserbase. The integrations also expose a `screenshot` tool, though it is documented as an agent tool, not as a post-failure debugging artifact. Missing for 10: step-by-step action timelines for agent runs, screenshot capture tied to replay debugging, replay for local or CDP-attached runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging a failed run.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can debug a failed agent run from recorded replays — video, screenshots, step-by-step action timelines

citations.quote: Browserbase provides real-time visibility into your automation sessions: **Session dashboard features** *   Real-time browser screen recording and replay
Each integration gives your agent one persistent browser and three tools: `run`, `snapshot`, and `screenshot`.
